title: Magic E (Silent E)
subject: Language Arts
description: The magic E at the end makes the vowel say its name!

video.title: Silent E | Phonics Song for Kids

steps: Magic E sits quietly at the END of a word. It makes no sound — it's silent!
But it has a magic power: it makes the vowel before it say its NAME (the long sound).
Watch the magic: cap → cape, kit → kite, hop → hope, cub → cube!
So 'tap' has short a (/a/), but 'tape' has long a (it says 'ay').

questions.prompt: What does Magic E do to the vowel in a word?
questions.hint: Magic E gives the vowel its long sound.

questions.prompt: Add Magic E to 'kit'. What word do you get?
questions.hint: k-i-t-e — the i says its name!

questions.prompt: Which word has a Magic E?
questions.hint: Look for the silent e at the end.

questions.prompt: Does Magic E make a sound when you say the word?
questions.hint: That's why it's also called Silent E!
